subject: Mutual Action Plan: Acme Maps - MAP & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmemaps.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery + MAP next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap so we have alignment on pain, goals, and the proposed mutual action plan (MAP).

Pain points you shared:
- High per-token cost and variability across workloads (batch vs real-time).
- Latency-sensitive features for in-product recommendations — target p95 < 300ms.
- Data residency and audit requirements for EU customers (future scope).

Goals:
- Validate a pilot that proves consistent latency and 30% TCO improvement over current baseline.
- Get a cost/throughput profile for both streaming chat and embedding use cases.
- Define decision criteria and timelines for a production roll-out (end of August target).

Proposed MAP (draft):
1) Pilot kickoff — scope & access (by 2026-08-09): Redwood provides reserved pilot pool, engineering onboarding, and guidance on prompts/traffic patterns.
2) Pilot validation — 2 weeks (2026-08-09 to 2026-08-23): metrics collection (latency, cost, quality) and architecture review.
3) Procurement & contract review — target signature (by 2026-08-30): commercial terms, SLR/SLA, and any compliance add-ons.
4) Production rollout plan — finalize by 2026-09-15.

Stakeholders (as we understand from the call):
- Jordan Smith (Product lead) — primary contact
- Samantha Lee (CTO) — technical decision maker
- Procurement (procurement@acmemaps.com) — purchasing

Next steps / asks for you:
- Confirm stakeholders and the decision timeline (end of August ok?).
- Confirm pilot start date (we recommended Aug 9) and any blackout weeks.
- Share any existing throughput/latency metrics you can for the first pilot dataset.

I attached a draft MAP (acme_map_map-v1.xlsx) and our standard SOW template for your procurement team to review. I can adjust dates after you confirm stakeholders.

If that looks right, I’ll circulate an updated MAP with milestones and owners and schedule a 30-min kickoff.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

--
Attachment: acme_map_map-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, MAP draft)
Attachment: redwood-map-sow-template.pdf (PDF, SOW template)

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmemaps.com>

Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmemaps.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + MAP next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Confirming the high-level alignment:
- Stakeholders: Samantha Lee (CTO, samantha.lee@acmemaps.com) will be the tech approver. Procurement is cc’d and will need the SOW + pricing for internal review.
- Decision timeline: we’re targeting end of August for an approval (aiming to have procurement review finished by the week of Aug 23).
- Pilot timing: Aug 9 start works for our engineering calendar; please note we have a company offsite week Aug 2-6.

I cc’d our procurement contact. They’ll want the SOW and the commercial proposal as soon as possible. Also, can you include an estimated cost range for the pilot (not a final quote) so procurement knows what to expect?

One note on scope: we want the pilot to include both streaming chat (user-facing) and an embedding rerank flow on a representative dataset (about 200k requests/day).

Thanks — I’ll confirm Samantha and procurement explicitly once they’ve reviewed the MAP.

Jordan
Product Lead, Acme Maps
jordan.smith@acmemaps.com

Thanks Jordan — great, that helps. I updated the MAP with the pilot scope to include both streaming chat and embeddings rerank and moved the kickoff to 2026-08-09 to avoid your offsite.

Quick updates in the attached revised MAP (acme_map_map-v1.xlsx):
- Pilot dates: 2026-08-09 to 2026-08-23
- Success criteria: p95 latency < 300ms (chat), embedding throughput 200k req/day with cost targets TBD after a first-week baseline.
- Owners: Marissa (Redwood AE) — commercial coordination; Mateo (Redwood SWE) — pilot engineering lead; Jordan (Acme) — product lead; Samantha (Acme) — tech approver.

I’ve also attached our SOW template for procurement. For the pilot estimate, a rough ballpark is $15k–$30k depending on sustained throughput and KV cache/capacity profile; we’ll firm up after the first week.

Next steps:
- Jordan / Samantha / Procurement to review map & SOW (target reply by 2026-07-28).
- I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for the week of Aug 9 after Jordan confirms a day/time.
- I’ll send a short engineering questionnaire to align on traffic shape and auth/access.

DocuSign/contract threads will follow once procurement confirms the initial scope.

Thanks,
